raw.query: WITH top_episodes AS ( SELECT b.rank_by_peak, b.start_ts, b.peak_ts, b.share_frames * 100.0 AS frame_pct, (b.share_single + b.share_tiled_small + b.share_tiled_large + b.share_frames) * 100.0 AS composition_pct FROM provenance.eda_burst_episode b JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND b.source_script = 'i_burst_anatomy' AND b.episode_kind = 'merged' AND b.rank_by_peak IS NOT NULL ), denominator AS ( SELECT value_num::int AS n_merged_episodes FROM provenance.eda_metric e JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND e.script = 'i_burst_anatomy' AND e.metric_path = 'n_merged_episodes' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_top_episodes, MAX(denominator.n_merged_episodes) AS n_merged_episodes, MIN(frame_pct) AS min_frame_pct, MAX(frame_pct) AS max_frame_pct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frame_pct < 93 OR frame_pct > 96) AS exact_outside_93_96, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ROUND(frame_pct) < 93 OR ROUND(frame_pct) > 96) AS whole_percent_outside_93_96, JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('rank', rank_by_peak, 'start_ts', start_ts, 'peak_ts', peak_ts, 'frame_pct', frame_pct, 'rounded_pct', ROUND(frame_pct), 'composition_pct', composition_pct) ORDER BY rank_by_peak) AS per_episode FROM top_episodes CROSS JOIN denominator
raw.observed: 6 top-ranked episodes among 18 merged episodes; frame shares are 96.2143400100809%, 96.42656785805838%, 94.77440669844393%, 93.06214356362716%, 92.7090520410356%, and 94.60543251814599%, rounding to 96%, 96%, 95%, 93%, 93%, and 95%; 0 fall outside 93-96% at the claim's whole-percent precision.
raw.claimed: The frames class supplies 93-96% of the image volume of every top episode.
raw.evidence: All 6 current, non-superseded top episodes round to frame shares within the stated whole-percent range; treating all 18 merged episodes as the denominator misreads “top episode.”
